author: blu
body: Proves Timetwister (the last Power Nine card). "Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library, then draws seven cards." compiles to the Timetwister effect; applying it wheels BOTH players: hand and graveyard go to the bottom of the library (a deterministic stand-in for the shuffle) and each player draws seven fresh cards. Here player 0 starts with library 8 / hand 2 / graveyard 1 (11 total): after the wheel the hand is 7, the graveyard is empty, and the library holds the remaining 4.
